character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout the full music video: long emerald-black hair in a practical braid, bright leaf-green eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a vertical-farm engineer maintaining living gardens high above the megacity. Fixed signature outfit: a white utility jumpsuit with green climbing harness, flexible gloves, and grip boots. Defining personal item: a compact pollination drone shaped like a hummingbird. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.
